title: Unauthenticated /add-webhook page renders the configured webhook validation token into the HTML
owner_hint: top committer: Steve Sanderson (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: OnInitialized copies WebhookClientOptions.Token into a field bound to an input, so it is emitted during prerender to anonymous visitors. The diff removes that assignment and resolves the token server-side inside RegisterAsync, keeping it out of component state and the DOM.
variants_checked: AddWebhook fixed; RegisteredHooks and ReceivedMessages are separate render sites; endpoints use the token server-side only.
bypass_considered: Even if the page were reachable, the configured token is no longer held in a bound field or rendered, so the HTML cannot disclose it.
test_note: No test added: no WebhookClient test project exists and the change is a one-field removal.
review_reason: The token-removal hunks are correct root-cause fixes, but the patch also adds [Authorize], an unrelated policy change that is inert anyway because Routes.razor uses RouteView instead of AuthorizeRouteView. Drop that hunk or ship it with the router change.
